subject.title: refactor: remove browser and codex dead exports

question: Does the exact current head remove only internal Browser/Codex exports while preserving all shipped plugin and upstream Codex contracts, and are any remaining dependency metadata changes intentional?
rationale: The protected label and mandatory direct Codex and dependency inspection require a human decision that cannot safely be inferred from the PR description and test results alone.

options.title: Approve after contract review
options.body: Inspect the exact-head exports, sibling Codex source, deleted coverage, and dependency delta, then merge when the remaining checks complete.

options.title: Split the ratchet repair
options.body: Separate LOC or dependency-adjacent changes if maintainers cannot establish that they form one necessary landing unit with the export cleanup.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract review
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact-head exports, sibling Codex source, deleted coverage, and dependency delta, then merge when the remaining checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the cleanup series and have the strongest supplied history for its intended Browser and Codex ownership boundaries.
